elaine_pm: Quick pickup  new routing editor iteration in Figma. Main asks: make priority ordering explicit, improve conflict validation copy, and verify keyboard reordering a11y.
rafa_design: I prototyped a compact numeric badge (editable) + hover/focus drag handle. Added a small "Preview" play icon per row to open a sandbox. Two copy options: (A) 'Priority: lower numbers run first.' (B) 'Lower numbers are evaluated before higher numbers (1 runs before 2). If equal, top-to-bottom order is used.'
noah_fe: Numeric edit + drag OK. Will validate inline: 'Must be a unique integer' and show inline conflict hint: 'Conflict with "Apply VAT"  both match same input; reorder or edit conditions.' Adding keyboard Move Up/Down buttons with aria-live announcements. Debounce preview runs to 500ms.
mina_research: From testing people want to type priorities. Inline edit + immediate feedback is good. For screen readers: announce 'Rule X moved to position 2 of 5' after drag/keyboard move; add aria-describedby for conflict hints.
ci-bot: Preview deploy: https://deploy-previews.redwood.sh/1870-routing-a11y-demo
elaine_pm: Thanks team. Rafa drop final Figma link + aria snippets here and I'll schedule the eng review.
